opening.argument: The video directs viewers to stake tokens through an external destination, instructs them to connect a wallet, and presents a displayed staking return of up to 952% APY. The offer is promoted as a passive-income opportunity, with the speaker urging viewers to follow the link and try it themselves. It also pairs the requested staking activity with assurances that balances will not be blocked and that funds and profits can be returned instantly. Those assurances do not cure the solicitation or the implausibly high yield tied to a deposit. The educational disclaimer and warning that cryptocurrency investment is high risk likewise do not change what the video asks viewers to do.
